cases.name: Camille Love McClanahan
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Camille worked as an Administrative Assistant for the Grant Co. Board of Education. Previously, she served as the Editorial Assistant for the Grant County News. She also trained as a EMT in Williamstown. She was a gifted photographer and served as a DJ for the Party Barn and will long be remembered for being a social butterfly. Organizing kid’s games at Halloween Parties every year brought her much delight. In the midst of this enormous loss, the force of Camille’s charming personality continues to give strength and courage in this time of despair. Camille leaves behind a space that no one else can fill."
